_meta.description: Nepal government holidays per MoHA gazette. General rest days only. Dashain and Tihar are multi-day blocks; Ghatasthapana is a separate day. Audience-limited days (women, education, valley, ethnic, disability, Kirat) are listed from festival_rules audience flags, not here. v1.4: drop Dashain sub-days, Vishwakarma, and Women's Day from the general list.
_meta.notes: Regional jatras and sub-days already covered by Dashain/Tihar ranges are excluded.
